data.name: HLP11_Body_IDcheck
data.value:
More and more organisations require you to add an ID check to the DigiD app. This gives more certainty that data is being shared with the right person. Your medical file, for example.
To perform the ID check, scan the chip on your identity document with the DigiD app. This is how we check your identity.
You can use the following Dutch identity documents: • Identity card • Passport • Drivers licence
We process the following data during the ID check: • Document number/driving licence number • Date of birth • Validity
This data is not stored.

data.name: HLP11_Body_Activate

The DigiD app automatically shows the options you can use.

data.name: DG018_Intro
data.value:
The ID check in the DigiD app is not possible with a passport or identity card without a citizen service number (BSN). Is there no BSN on your Dutch passport or identity card? And was your identity document issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, a border municipality, the Schiphol desk or a Caribbean issuing authority? Then you cannot perform the ID check. You did not yet have a BSN when you applied for your identity document.
What can you do? • The ID check is not always required to log in. If you wanted to activate the DigiD app using the ID check, you can skip this step. You can activate the app via SMS verification. • You can also apply for a new passport or identity card.
Do you live in the Netherlands? Arrange this with your municipality. Do you live abroad? Visit the website of NetherlandsWorldwide. When you apply, indicate that you have a citizen service number (BSN) and that it should be included on your identity document. Once you have your new identity document, you can still add the ID check to the DigiD app.
